description: Single mechanical source of truth for deep-research depth-mode constants. The prose tables in SKILL.md and reference/methodology.md are views of this file, not independent definitions. scripts/citation_manager.py reads it at init-run; tests/test_modes_config.py fails if it drifts from the constants the scripts enforce.

field_notes.research_lanes: Planned retrieval lanes emitted into plan.json. Must equal MODE_LANE_TARGETS in audit_manifest.py and len(MODE_LANE_DEFAULTS[mode]) in citation_manager.py.
field_notes.query_families_per_lane: Guidance range for distinct query families per lane; not mechanically enforced.
field_notes.material_claim_target_per_lane: Guidance target for material claims a lane should land; not mechanically enforced.
field_notes.judge_candidate_cap: Upper bound on the semantic-judge selection per run. Bounds the P0-A packet accounting only; it never caps extract_claims.py, which must stay exhaustive for the deterministic gate. Overflow is prioritized material-first and recorded as a run_status partial trigger.
field_notes.judge_packets: Round-robin verifier shards the judge selection is split across, each validated for exact claim-ID coverage (P0-A).
field_notes.research_subagents: Concurrent research subagents. ultradeep is pinned at exactly 4 by CLAUDE.md.
field_notes.source_floor: Minimum unique retained sources. Must equal MODE_SOURCE_TARGETS in audit_manifest.py.
field_notes.worker_model_hint: Per-tree value. The Claude tree pins Sonnet 5; the Codex tree pins gpt-5.6-sol. Authoritative routing stays in citation_manager.py ROLE_EXECUTION_BUDGETS.
